Title: CyrenaBuilder - Application Builder
Summary: The main application builder for Cyréna. Configures DI services, feature options, assemblies, build actions, and run actions. Central to bootstrapping the application.
Content:
## CyrenaBuilder

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Options`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
The main application builder for Cyréna. Used to configure the entire application before building the service provider.

### Constructor
```csharp
public CyrenaBuilder(IServiceCollection services)
```

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Services` | `IServiceCollection` | The DI service collection |
| `FeatureAssemblies` | `IDictionary<string, IList<Assembly>>` | Assemblies grouped by feature key |
| `FeatureOptions` | `IDictionary<string, object>` | Named feature configuration objects |
| `BuildActions` | `IList<Action<CyrenaBuilder>>` | Actions run during Build() |
| `RunActions` | `IList<Action<IServiceProvider, CancellationToken>>` | Actions run after service provider is built |

### Methods

#### AddFeatureOption<T>(T option)
Adds a named feature option object. Throws if already added.

#### GetFeatureOption(string name)
Retrieves a feature option by name. Returns null if not found.

#### GetFeatureOption<T>()
Retrieves a feature option by type name. Throws `NullReferenceException` if not found.

#### AddFeatureAssembly(string key, Assembly assembly)
Adds an assembly to a feature group.

#### AddBuildAction(Action<CyrenaBuilder> action)
Adds an action to run during Build().

#### AddRunAction(Action<IServiceProvider, CancellationToken> action)
Adds an action to run after the service provider is built.

#### Build()
Executes all BuildActions and registers `CyrenaOptions` as a singleton.

#### GetLifetimeCT() / CancelLifetimeCT()
Manages the application lifetime cancellation token.

### Extension Methods (in CyrenaBuilderExtensions)
- `AddAssistantMode<T>()` - Registers an assistant mode
- `AddAssistantPlugin<T>()` - Registers an assistant plugin
- `AddStartupTask<T>()` - Registers a startup task
- `AddSettingsComponent<T>()` - Adds a Blazor settings component
- `AddShortcut<T>()` - Adds a UI shortcut

### Usage Example
```csharp
var builder = new CyrenaBuilder(services);
builder.AddComponents();
builder.AddExtensaComponents();
builder.AddOllama();
builder.AddOpenAI();
builder.AddAssistantMode<DefaultAssistantMode>();
builder.AddAssistantPlugin<DefaultAssistantPlugin>();
builder.Build();
```
